prompt: Each face of a cube has area $25$ square units. What is the **total surface area**?
hint: Total surface area adds up every face. On a cube, all the faces have the same area.

hints.text: Total surface area adds up every face. On a cube, all the faces have the same area.
There are $6$ faces and each one has area $25$. Multiply $6 \times 25$ to add them all at once.
$6 \times 25 = 150$, so the total surface area is $150$ square units.

explanation: The total surface area is the sum of the areas of all the faces.
A cube has $6$ equal faces, and each has area $25$ square units.
Multiply the number of faces by the area of each: $6 \times 25 = 150$.
The total surface area of the cube is $150$ square units.
